name: Mini Massager - Rechargeable Shoulder/ Neck/ Muscle/ Tendonitis/ Deep Tissue/ Back Massager with 1pcs Butterfly Pad
description:
Product Name: Mini Rechargeable Massager with 1pcs Butterfly Pad
Generic Name: Pain Relief Massager
Origin: Made in China (Country of Origin Mentioned: India)
Weight: 100g
Dimensions: 17 × 9 × 3 cm

Specifications

Charging Voltage: 5V DC

Working Voltage: 20mA

Charging Current: 180mA

Pads Included: 2pcs Butterfly Pad

Key Features

Designed for shoulder, neck, muscle, tendonitis & back massage

Provides deep tissue relaxation & pain relief

Rechargeable & portable – easy to carry anywhere

Lightweight design for convenient daily use
